subject: english
q: The clock shows the exact time, so it is ____.
explain: accurate 指「準確的」，符合時間完全正確的線索；actual 是「實際的」，current 是「目前的」。

subject: english
q: Every room is booked tonight, so none is ____ for anyone else to book.
explain: available 意為「可供使用的」；所有房間都已訂滿，因此沒有空房，occupied 則是「已被占用的」。

subject: english
q: Water is ____ for survival; people cannot live without it.
explain: essential 意為「不可或缺的」；不能沒有水的線索，排除表示「非必要的」optional。

subject: english
q: Nothing unusual happened; it was just an ____ day.
explain: ordinary 意為「平凡的」；nothing unusual 表示沒有不尋常的事，exceptional 則是「非凡的」。

subject: english
q: Mia is ____; she gladly shares her food and money with others.
explain: generous 意為「慷慨的」，願意分享食物與金錢；selfish 是「自私的」，greedy 是「貪心的」。

subject: english
q: This is a ____ office; we will leave it when repairs to our building are finished.
explain: temporary 意為「暫時的」；大樓修好就會搬離，並非 permanent「永久的」辦公室。

subject: english
q: Although she knew the answer, fear of being wrong made her ____ before speaking.
explain: hesitate 意為「猶豫」；雖知道答案，卻因怕答錯而遲疑，insist 則是「堅持」。

subject: english
q: The museum controls light and temperature to ____ its ancient paintings from damage.
explain: preserve 意為「保存、保護」；控制光線與溫度是為了防止古畫受損，replace 是「取代」。

subject: english
q: The twins look so alike that I cannot ____ one from the other.
explain: distinguish 意為「區分、辨別」；雙胞胎太像而難以分辨，distract 是「使分心」。

subject: english
q: After a week of rest, Leo began to ____ from the flu and felt much better.
explain: recover from 意為「從……康復」；休息後病況好轉，suffer from 則是「受……所苦」。

subject: english
q: This machine does the same work with less energy, making it more ____.
explain: efficient 意為「有效率的」；完成同樣工作卻耗能較少，是效率提升，不一定代表更 powerful「強大的」。

subject: english
q: My skin is ____ to this soap; it becomes red and sore.
explain: sensitive 意為「敏感的」，皮膚接觸肥皂後發紅疼痛符合語境；sensible 則是「明智的」。

subject: english
q: Eva was ____ to lend her car, so she agreed only after repeated requests.
explain: reluctant 意為「不情願的」；多次請求後才同意，不能選 eager「渴望的」或 willing「樂意的」。

subject: english
q: An ____ delay is one that cannot be prevented, no matter what we do.
explain: inevitable 意為「不可避免的」；即使努力也無法防止，與 accidental「偶然的」意思不同。

subject: english
q: To remain ____, the judge relied on evidence rather than personal feelings.
explain: objective 在此是「客觀的」，強調依證據判斷；emotional 是「情緒化的」，sympathetic 是「同情的」。

subject: english
q: His account stayed ____; every retelling contained the same details.
explain: consistent 意為「一致的」；每次重述細節都相同，variable 則是「會變動的」。

subject: english
q: The repairs cost a ____ amount, so the final bill was extremely high.
explain: considerable 意為「相當大的」；帳單金額極高，不能選表示「少量的」modest 或「微不足道的」trivial。

subject: english
q: The treatment has ____ benefits, but further tests must show whether it actually helps.
explain: potential 意為「潛在的、可能的」；療效仍待測試，不能說是 proven「已證實的」或 guaranteed「有保證的」。

subject: english
q: Without exact figures, we can only ____ how much the repairs will cost.
explain: estimate 意為「估計」；缺少確切數據只能估算，confirm 是「確認」，guarantee 是「保證」。

subject: english
q: The teacher repeated the warning to ____ the importance of online safety.
explain: emphasize 意為「強調」；重複警告是為了凸顯網路安全的重要性，conceal 是「隱瞞」。

subject: english
q: A ____ is a result of an action; for example, missing class may lead to falling behind.
explain: consequence 意為「結果、後果」；缺課導致進度落後是因果關係，coincidence 則是「巧合」。

subject: english
q: We cannot use Plan A, so we need an ____, such as Plan B.
explain: alternative 作名詞指「替代方案」；原計畫不可行，便需要另一個方案，exception 是「例外」。

subject: english
q: When water is scarce, there is plenty of it.
explain: scarce 意為「缺乏的、稀少的」；plenty of 是「大量的」，兩者意思相反。

subject: english
q: A precise measurement is exact rather than rough.
explain: precise 意為「精確的」；exact 是「確切的」，rough 在此是「粗略的」。

subject: english
q: To assume something is to accept it as true without being certain.
explain: assume 意為「假定、認為」，表示尚未確定就暫時當作真實，並不等於證實。

subject: english
q: In 'We eventually arrived after several delays,' eventually means immediately.
explain: eventually 意為「最後、終於」；多次延誤後才抵達，不是 immediately「立刻」。

subject: english
q: In 'Please reserve a table for six,' reserve means book in advance.
explain: reserve 在此意為「預訂」；book in advance 就是「事先預訂」，不是現場挑選。

subject: english
q: In 'She politely declined the invitation,' declined means accepted.
explain: decline 在邀請的語境中意為「婉拒」，與 accept「接受」相反。

subject: english
q: In 'The project produced a modest profit,' modest means enormous.
explain: modest 在修飾金額時指「不大的、有限的」，不是 enormous「龐大的」，也不是指人的謙虛。

subject: english
q: In 'The business plans to expand abroad,' expand means become larger.
explain: expand 意為「擴展、擴大」；expand abroad 指拓展海外業務，abroad 是「在國外、到國外」。

subject: english
q: The puzzle was difficult, but Sue refused to ____ and kept trying.
explain: give up 意為「放棄」；kept trying 表示持續嘗試，give away 是「贈送、洩漏」。

subject: english
q: We have ____ milk, so there is none left for breakfast.
explain: run out of 意為「用完」；none left 表示一點也沒剩，run into 是「偶然遇見」。

subject: english
q: Could you ____ my cat by feeding her while I am away?
explain: look after 意為「照顧」；需要替貓餵食，look for 是「尋找」，look into 是「調查」。

subject: english
q: Everyone can take part ____ the school festival; no experience is required.
explain: take part in 是「參加」活動的固定搭配，介系詞用 in。

subject: english
q: Her parents are proud ____ her honesty, even though she lost the game.
explain: be proud of 意為「以……為榮」；honesty 是「誠實」，此處為父母感到驕傲的原因。

subject: english
q: The outdoor concert was ____ until next Friday because of the storm.
explain: put off 意為「延期」；until next Friday 提供時間線索，put out 是「撲滅」，put on 是「穿上、上演」。

subject: english
q: I look forward to ____ from you soon.
explain: look forward to 意為「期待」，to 是介系詞，後接動名詞 hearing；hearing from you 是「收到你的消息」。

subject: english
q: The fence prevents children ____ entering the construction site.
explain: prevent A from V-ing 意為「阻止 A 做某事」；construction site 是「工地」。

subject: english
q: With his injured ankle, Tom could not ____ the faster runners.
explain: keep up with 意為「跟上」；腳踝受傷使他跟不上，catch up on 是「補做、補上」。

subject: english
q: Each team member is responsible ____ checking one part of the report.
explain: be responsible for 意為「負責……」；後接 checking「檢查」，說明負責的工作。

subject: english
q: You need to ____ an effort if you want to improve your pronunciation.
explain: make an effort 意為「努力」，動詞固定搭配 make；pronunciation 是「發音」。

subject: english
q: When choosing a phone, take battery life into ____, not just the price.
explain: take ... into account 意為「把……納入考量」；battery life 是「電池續航力」。

subject: english
q: After hours of discussion, the team finally ____ a workable solution.
explain: come up with 意為「想出」；討論後提出可行解決辦法，come down with 是「罹患」。

subject: english
q: The noise is unbearable; I cannot ____ it any longer.
explain: put up with 意為「忍受」；unbearable 是「難以忍受的」，get along with 多指「與……相處」。

subject: english
q: The film was disappointing; it failed to live up ____ my expectations.
explain: live up to expectations 意為「符合期望」；disappointing 表示「令人失望的」，所以未達期望。

subject: english
q: If a car breaks down, it stops working.
explain: break down 用於車輛或機器時意為「故障」，也就是停止正常運作。

subject: english
q: To take after a parent means to look after that parent.
explain: take after 意為「外貌或個性像」某位家人；look after 才是「照顧」。

subject: english
q: 'In spite of the rain' and 'despite the rain' express the same contrast.
explain: in spite of 與 despite 都表示「儘管」；兩者後方可直接接名詞，despite 後不加 of。

subject: english
q: In 'Look up the word in a dictionary,' look up means search for information.
explain: look up 在字典情境中指「查閱」；search for information 是「查找資訊」。

subject: english
q: In 'He turned down the offer,' turned down means lowered the volume.
explain: turn down 在此指「拒絕」提議；受詞是音量或設備時，才可表示「調小音量」。

subject: english
q: Listen! Someone ____ at the door right now.
explain: right now 是「現在」，配合 Listen! 可知敲門正在發生，用現在進行式 is knocking。

subject: english
q: I ____ my grandparents yesterday afternoon.
explain: yesterday afternoon 是「昨天下午」，明確指出過去時間，動詞用過去式 visited「探望了」。

subject: english
q: Nora ____ in Taipei since 2020 and still lives there.
explain: since 2020 是「自二〇二〇年以來」，且現在仍居住在臺北，用現在完成式 has lived。

subject: english
q: I missed the train because it ____ before I reached the station.
explain: 火車在「我抵達」這個過去動作之前就已離開，用過去完成式 had left「已經離開」。

subject: english
q: I will call you as soon as I ____ home tomorrow.
explain: as soon as 意為「一……就……」；表示未來的時間副詞子句用現在式 get，不用 will get。

subject: english
q: The girl ____ won the race is my sister.
explain: 先行詞 girl 是「女孩」，關係代名詞在子句中作主詞，用 who；whose 表示「誰的」。

subject: english
q: I know a student ____ father teaches at our school.
explain: whose 意為「其……的」，修飾 father「父親」，whose father 就是「那位學生的父親」。

subject: english
q: The bus, ____ was already full, drove past us.
explain: bus 是「公車」，非限定關係子句補充說明事物時用 which，不能用 that。

subject: english
q: ____ by the sudden noise, the baby began to cry.
explain: 嬰兒是「受到驚嚇」的一方，用過去分詞 Frightened；frightening 意為「令人害怕的」。

subject: english
q: ____ all her money, Nina could not afford a bus ticket.
explain: 花光錢發生在買不起車票之前，且 Nina 是主動花錢，用 Having spent「已花光」引導分詞構句。

subject: english
q: If I ____ you, I would apologize to her.
explain: 與現在事實相反的假設，用 If I were you「如果我是你」；apologize 是「道歉」。

subject: english
q: If Ben had set an alarm, he ____ the early train yesterday.
explain: had set an alarm 是「當時有設鬧鐘」的過去反事實假設，主句用 would have caught「本來會趕上」。

subject: english
q: I wish I ____ more time now, but the deadline is in an hour.
explain: wish 後表達與現在事實相反的願望，用過去式 had「有」；now 排除表示過去遺憾的 had had。

subject: english
q: Never ____ such a beautiful sunset before.
explain: 否定副詞 Never「從未」放句首時需倒裝，助動詞 have 移至主詞 I 前，seen 是 see 的過去分詞。

subject: english
q: ____ it was raining, the players continued the game instead of stopping.
explain: Although 意為「雖然」，可直接接完整子句；despite「儘管」與 because of「因為」後接名詞或動名詞。

subject: english
q: This bag is much ____ than that one.
explain: than 是「比……」，需用比較級 lighter「較輕的」；much 可加強比較級，不能再加 more。

subject: english
q: The classroom must ____ before the visitors arrive.
explain: 教室是被打掃的對象，must 後接原形 be 再加過去分詞 cleaned，表示「必須被打掃」。

subject: english
q: She avoided ____ the question because she did not know the answer.
explain: avoid 意為「避免」，後接動名詞 answering 作受詞，不能接 to answer。

subject: english
q: 'Children' is the plural form of 'child'.
explain: child 意為「小孩」，不規則複數為 children，不是在字尾直接加 s。

subject: english
q: 'She don't like coffee' is grammatically correct in standard written English.
explain: She 是第三人稱單數，否定助動詞須改為 does not 或 doesn't；like coffee 是「喜歡咖啡」。

subject: english
q: In 'Neither of the answers is correct,' the singular verb 'is' is correct.
explain: Neither of 表示「兩者之中沒有一個」；本句用單數動詞 is 正確，answer 是「答案」。

subject: english
q: 'There is few milk left' is grammatically correct in standard written English.
explain: milk「牛奶」是不可數名詞，應改用 little；few 修飾可數複數名詞，兩者均可表示「幾乎沒有」。

subject: english
q: 'She asked where did he live' has correct word order in standard written English.
explain: 間接問句用直述句語序，應為 She asked where he lived；where he lived 意為「他住在哪裡」。

subject: english
q: 'I saw him crossing the street' can describe an action in progress.
explain: 感官動詞 saw 後接受詞與現在分詞 crossing，可表示看見「他正在過馬路」，強調動作進行中。

subject: english
q: In 'She had her bike repaired,' she necessarily repaired the bike herself.
explain: 本句的 have + 受詞 + 過去分詞是使役用法；had her bike repaired 表示「請人修腳踏車」，不能推論是她親自修理。

subject: english
q: The driver checked the brakes ____ before the trip.
explain: 修飾動詞 checked「檢查」須用副詞 carefully「仔細地」；careful 是形容詞，意為「仔細的」。

subject: english
q: Her ____ in the competition made her family proud.
explain: Her ____ in the competition 整體作主詞，空格須填名詞 success「成功」；successful 是形容詞，succeed 是動詞。

subject: english
q: Which word is formed by joining two nouns?
explain: bedroom「臥室」由名詞 bed「床」與 room「房間」組成；其餘分別在字根加上字首 un- 或字尾 -less、-ly。

subject: english
q: To ____ a message is to understand it incorrectly.
explain: misunderstand 意為「誤解」，字首 mis- 表「錯誤地」；misplace 是「放錯地方」，mislead 是「誤導」。

subject: english
q: The suffix '-able' in 'reusable' means ____.
explain: 此處字尾 -able 表示「能被……的」，搭配 reuse「重複使用」，reusable 就是「可重複使用的」。

subject: english
q: Adding '-ment' to 'develop' forms a ____.
explain: develop 是動詞「發展」，加字尾 -ment 成為名詞 development「發展」，noun 就是「名詞」。

subject: english
q: It was ____ of you to lower your voice while the baby was sleeping.
explain: considerate 意為「體貼的」，降低音量是不打擾嬰兒的表現；considerable 是「相當大的」。

subject: english
q: This car is ____ because it uses very little fuel.
explain: 此處用形容詞 economical「節省的」作主詞補語，表示車子省油；economically 是副詞，economy 與 economics 是名詞。

subject: english
q: The word 'abundant' is closest in meaning to ____.
explain: abundant 與 plentiful 都是「充足的、豐富的」；scarce 是「稀少的」，limited 是「有限的」。

subject: english
q: The opposite of 'optimistic' is ____.
explain: optimistic 是「樂觀的」，反義詞為 pessimistic「悲觀的」；realistic 是「務實的」，不必然悲觀。

subject: english
q: The ____ was asked about her work experience during the job interview.
explain: applicant 是「申請者、應徵者」，字尾 -ant 可表示人；application 是名詞「申請、申請書」。

subject: english
q: 'Unhappy' means not happy; 'un-' changes the meaning to its opposite.
explain: unhappy 意為「不快樂的」；此處字首 un- 表示「不」，使 happy「快樂的」變為反義。

subject: english
q: 'Careless' means full of care.
explain: careless 是「粗心的」，字尾 -less 表示「缺乏」；careful 才是「小心的、仔細的」。

subject: english
q: 'Please advice me' uses the correct verb form.
explain: 應改為 Please advise me「請給我建議」；advise 是動詞，advice 則是不可數名詞「建議」。

subject: english
q: 'Obtain' and 'acquire' can both mean get something.
explain: obtain 與 acquire 都可表示「取得、獲得」；兩字在此作動詞，與 get 的這個意思相近。

subject: english
q: A: Could you help me carry this box? B: ____
explain: Sure. Let me help you. 意為「當然，讓我幫你」，適合回應請求；You are welcome. 是「不客氣」。

subject: english
q: A: Thanks for lending me your notes. B: ____
choices: I am sorry to hear that.
explain: You are welcome. 意為「不客氣」，用來回應感謝；lending me your notes 是「借我筆記」。

subject: english
q: We expected the small room to be uncomfortable; ____, we found it pleasant.
explain: however 意為「然而」；預期房間不舒適，實際卻覺得宜人，兩者形成轉折，不能用表因果的 therefore「因此」。

subject: english
q: The last bus had left; ____, we had to walk home.
explain: therefore 意為「因此」；末班公車已離開是走路回家的原因，meanwhile 是「同時」。

subject: english
q: 'Otherwise' in 'Hurry; otherwise, you will miss the train' means ____.
explain: otherwise 意為「否則」，本句指「如果不趕快」就會錯過火車；even if 則是「即使」。

subject: english
q: A: Do you mind if I sit here? B: ____ The seat is free.
choices: Yes, I do. Please find another seat.
I am afraid so. This seat is taken.
Sorry, I am saving it for a friend.
explain: Do you mind ...? 是「你介意……嗎」；Not at all. Go ahead. 表示「完全不介意，請坐」。

subject: english
q: A: I missed the deadline and cannot apply. B: ____
explain: That is a shame. 意為「真可惜」，回應錯過申請期限的遺憾；deadline 是「截止期限」。

subject: english
q: Saying 'I am afraid I cannot' is a polite way to refuse a request.
explain: I am afraid I cannot 意為「恐怕我沒辦法」，可用來委婉拒絕請求，afraid 在此不表示害怕。

subject: english
q: 'In addition' introduces a contrast between two opposing ideas.
explain: in addition 意為「此外」，用來補充資訊；however「然而」才可引出不同想法之間的轉折。

subject: english
q: 'You cannot enter unless you have a ticket' means a ticket is required for entry.
explain: unless 意為「除非、如果不」；本句表示沒有票就不能進入，票是入場必要條件，未保證有票就一定能入場。
